s: Hilkiah is a high priest
q: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest

s: Josiah has son Jehoahaz
q: The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him

s: man of God has tomb in Bethel (he came from Judah; Josiah left his bones undisturbed)
q: “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel.”

s: Josiah has son Jehoiakim (originally named Eliakim)
q: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim

s: Josiah killed by Pharaoh Necoh (at Megiddo)
q: King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

s: Josiah buried in his own tomb (in Jerusalem)
q: brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb.

s: Passover kept in Jerusalem (eighteenth year of Josiah; unmatched since the judges)
q: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to the LORD in Jerusalem.

s: Passover is commanded by Josiah (as written in the book of the covenant)
q: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to the LORD your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”

s: Jehoiakim is servant of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon (for three years, then rebelled)
q: Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

s: Zedekiah is uncle of Jehoiachin king of Judah (father's brother; originally named Mattaniah)
q: Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

s: Zedekiah has age at accession twenty-one years
q: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

s: Zedekiah reigns in Jerusalem (eleven years)
q: he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

s: Zedekiah does evil in sight of LORD (like Jehoiakim)
q: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

s: Zedekiah rebels against Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
q: Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

s: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon rules Babylon
q: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up

s: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon holds territory brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates (taken from the king of Egypt)
q: for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

s: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon carries away captives of Jerusalem (carried by Nebuchadnezzar) (ten thousand captives)
q: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths.

s: LORD sends against judah Chaldeans (with Syrians, Moabites, Ammonites, to destroy Judah)
q: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it

s: LORD removes from his sight Judah (for the sins of Manasseh)
q: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh

s: Jehoiakim is father of Jehoiachin king of Judah
q: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

s: Manasseh fills with innocent blood Jerusalem (LORD would not pardon)
q: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.

s: Jerusalem is besieged by servants of Nebuchadnezzar
q: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

s: Judah is destroyed by anger of LORD (Jerusalem and Judah cast out from his presence)
q: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence.

s: captives of Jerusalem (carried by Nebuchadnezzar) includes princes, mighty men of valor, craftsmen and smiths (ten thousand captives)
q: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths.

s: Babylonian exile/deportation of Judah leaves behind poorest people of the land
q: No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

s: siege of Jerusalem occurs in Jerusalem (Nebuchadnezzar came while servants besieged it)
q: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah reigns over Judah (succeeded Jehoiakim)
q: Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah has age at accession eighteen years
q: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah reigns in Jerusalem (three months)
q: he reigned in Jerusalem three months.

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah has mother Nehushta
q: His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah does evil in sight of LORD (like his father)
q: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah is captive of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon (captured in the eighth year of his reign; carried to Babylon)
q: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land.

s: Zedekiah is installed king by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon (in place of Jehoiachin)
q: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

s: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is a king of Babylon
q: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem

s: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah has father Nethaniah
q: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring

s: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah has lineage royal offspring
q: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah is a king of Judah
q: Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah receives continual daily allowance from the king (all the days of his life)
q: there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

s: Jehoiachin king of Judah has position throne above other kings in Babylon (set by Evilmerodach)
q: set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

s: Evilmerodach king of Babylon releases Jehoiachin king of Judah (from prison, in the year he began to reign)
q: Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

s: Babylonian exile/deportation of Judah has state Judah carried away captive out of his land
q: So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

s: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appoints governor Gedaliah (over the people left in Judah)
q: even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

s: siege of Jerusalem lasts until eleventh year of King Zedekiah
q: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

s: Zedekiah is a king of Judah
q: until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah

s: Zedekiah state blinded and bound in fetters (carried to Babylon)
q: then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

s: Nebuzaradan is a captain of the guard (servant of the king of Babylon)
q: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon

s: LORD's house state burned (by Nebuzaradan)
q: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem.

s: Gedaliah is a governor (over the people left in Judah)
q: even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

s: Gedaliah has father Ahikam
q: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan

s: Gedaliah resides in Mizpah (governor's seat where the captains came to him)
q: they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah

s: Jehoram is son of Ahab
q: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria

s: Jehoshaphat is allied with Jehoram (pledged support against Moab)
q: I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.

s: Elisha is son of Shaphat
q: Elisha the son of Shaphat

s: Elisha is a prophet of the LORD
q: Isn’t there a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat

s: Elisha served Elijah (poured water on his hands)
q: who poured water on the hands of Elijah

s: Elisha has the LORD's word (per Jehoshaphat)
q: The LORD’s word is with him.

s: Elisha stands before LORD (as servant)
q: As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand

s: Mesha is a sheep breeder
q: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder

s: Mesha rules Moab (king)
q: Mesha king of Moab

s: Mesha supplied lambs and wool tribute (to the king of Israel)
q: he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.
